all12.oracle: Directed MPFR bounds; both endpoints round to the same binary64 (RNE).
all12.abi: Every call verifies R4-R11, SP, bounded stack writes.
all12.semantics: RNE return values; errno and floating exception flags are not implemented.
all12.nan_result_policy: NaN results must be quiet; payload and sign are unspecified.
known_limitations: An undecided owned 1024-bit pow refinement still traps; all-input totality is unproved.
all12.scope: Finite corpus, not an exhaustive proof over every binary64 input.

asin_acos_edges.oracle: Directed MPFR bounds; inverse output midpoints bracketed by directed MPFR sin/cos. Reduction/normalization/endpoint neighborhoods included.
asin_acos_edges.scope: Finite ARM input corpus. Complete rounding intervals are certified separately.

root_arm.oracle: Exact arbitrary-precision N=2^126-X^2, binary64 input rounding, integer sqrt midpoint tests, quotient and interval comparisons.
root_arm.scope: Every top16bit X bucket at both legal endpoints, normalization boundaries and deterministic binary64 inputs. ABI, bounded stack writes and pending SIO preservation checked. General error enclosure is certified separately.

m4.scope: Cortex-M4 O3 release, both soft and hard float ABIs: normalized preprocessing and every allocated code/data section identical; existing M4 runtime sources byte-identical

generic_m0.scope: Non-RP2040 generic ARMv6-M: every allocated code/data section remains byte-identical to V60. The generic spelling has an extra expression macro; normalized preprocessing identity is not claimed.

hardware.method: Owned code retains its production flash/SRAM placement; Qfplib executes from flash. Identical input order, twelve calibrated rounds with six first runs per library, TIMERAWL, typed soft-float calls and matching calibration leaves. The primary estimator is the median of six opposite-order pair averages. Interrupts enabled. XIP hit/access counters sampled outside timing; include both cores, with paired control counts recorded. Owned math addresses and bytes match production; Qfplib is isolated at 0x10180000. Both libraries warm up inside the APP for at least 1000000 us before timing.
hardware.scope: Physical RP2040 timings; finite controlled workloads. Group times weight per-chunk estimates by case count. New reports use medians of opposite-order pair averages from twelve calibrated rounds; legacy reports retain per-library medians from nine rounds. Raw batches and both summaries remain available. Qfplib output error is reported separately.
hardware.comparison_scope: Explicit Qfplib compositions and algebraic shortcuts, not native Qfplib entry points. Results are independently checked against MPFR; each stream states its base/exponent domain.

groups_data.reference_formula: y=1:x; y=-1:div(1,x); y=2:mul(x,x); y=0.5:sqrt(x); y=-0.5:div(1,sqrt(x)); otherwise exp(mul(y,ln(x)))

order_balanced.method: Average each adjacent pair of rounds with opposite library order, then take the median of those pair averages. The empirical range is not a confidence interval.
